importance_ranking.reason: Poultry sheds, dairy shelters, grain godowns, and equipment sheds are visually distinct building types — buyers use the image to confirm the correct structure type before reading any text. Absence of image causes immediate skip for a capital purchase where visual confirmation of build quality is the first trust signal.

Span width, roof type, cladding material, and ventilation design are non-interchangeable requirements — a poultry shed buyer cannot substitute a grain storage spec. Listings without these specs cannot be evaluated for structural and functional fit.

Indian agricultural buyers compare per-sq-ft rates aggressively across multiple suppliers once building type is confirmed. Price varies substantially with span, cladding type, and insulation specification — buyers discover and compare across spec tiers during search, making this a spec-driven price signal.

importance_ranking.unit_note: Standard shed types (poultry, dairy, grain storage) are quoted per sq ft in the Indian market; large turnkey multi-structure farm complexes may be quoted per project. Unit must be shown to prevent price comparison confusion between these two quoting conventions.
importance_ranking.reason: Per sq ft vs per project is a real market ambiguity — without the unit, a buyer cannot compare prices across listings. Per sq ft is the dominant unit for standard agricultural shed types and must be displayed alongside price.

importance_ranking.brand_important_reason: No dominant brand with buyer recall exists in this category — the market is fragmented across regional PEB fabricators and buyers search by building type and spec, not manufacturer name.
importance_ranking.reason: Seller installation capability, erection track record, and post-sale service network are evaluated during vendor selection for a construction project, but these are confirmed after spec and price shortlisting. Company is a qualifier, not a primary discovery signal.

top_configurator_specs.reason: Defines the product class — poultry shed, dairy shed, grain storage, equipment shed are structurally non-interchangeable and carry the largest price delta across the spec list due to differing span, height, ventilation, and flooring requirements.
Defines the enclosure quality tier — GI sheet vs insulated sandwich panel vs polycarbonate creates a significant price delta and is the primary material cost driver after the steel frame.

missing_important_specs.why_important: Span width (clear column-free interior width) is the primary structural sizing dimension for PEB agricultural buildings — buyers specify their required span and sellers cannot confirm structural feasibility or quote accurately without it.

Insulated sandwich panels vs bare GI sheet is a major price and performance differentiator — poultry and dairy shed buyers specifically require thermal insulation for animal welfare compliance, and this is not captured by Cladding Material alone.

top_rfq_specs.reason: Routes the RFQ to sellers who specialise in the specific building type — a poultry shed supplier may not supply mushroom farm or agri warehouse structures, so this spec immediately determines seller fit.
Determines the quality tier and price range of the structure — insulated panel vs GI sheet is a major price differentiator that sellers need to confirm before quoting accurately.

missing_important_specs.why_important: Sellers cannot confirm structural feasibility or quote accurately without knowing the buyer's required clear span — a fabricator who only builds up to 12m spans cannot supply a 30m dairy shed.
